archetype_rationale: The team is 'dedicated to enabling ecosystem partners' and the day-to-day is building POCs, reference architectures, and production deployments to help 'enterprise developers move from prototype to real-world impact' — a hands-on builder embedded with external partners, the forward-deployed pattern rather than internal product building.
notes: agent-builder is a very close second archetype — every responsibility bullet is agentic-system construction; the partner-enablement framing is what tips it to FDE. JD also emphasizes coding-agent-assisted development (Codex, Claude Code) and synthetic data/eval experience as a hard requirement, plus GPU inference cost-quality tradeoffs (NVIDIA-specific) — resume should surface any synthetic-eval and cost/latency work. Comp band $152k–$241.5k, Santa Clara.
